instruction: A candid documentary photograph captured in a medium shot at eye-level, showing a couple at a restaurant table against a dark green paneled wall. On the left, the woman in the white hijab (R1) sits in a white dress, looking to the right with a calm, attentive expression. On the right, the man in the white button-down shirt (R2) sits facing her, looking back with a gentle smile. They are seated close together at a dining table with tableware in the foreground. The man (R2) has his arm resting on the booth behind the woman (R1) as they maintain direct eye contact. The lighting is soft and natural, casting gentle shadows and creating an intimate, quiet mood.
